_about: Which paths each local agent may change when two agents share this checkout. Paths are relative to the repo root; a trailing / means the whole folder. A path no lane lists is open to both (AGENTS.md stream rules still apply). Pick a lane with AGENT_LANE=<name>; see AGENTS.md, 'Two agents in one checkout'.

backend.about: The Python design workflow (agent/) and every repo-level file: deps, docs, tooling, agent config

frontend.about: The Nothingburger site in frontend/ (plain HTML, CSS and JS, no build step), except frontend/robot-design/

robot-design.about: The Robot Design page in frontend/robot-design/, opened by the Design robot button
